tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Search Dutch marketing agencies by specialisms, target_industry (the client vertical the agency serves), city, B2B/B2C, client company size, budget band, agency_size (the agency's own team size per KvK) and an optional radius (near_city = any Dutch city, or near_lat/near_lon, always combined with within_km in kilometres). specialisms filters against the taxonomy; a term outside it is mapped to the nearest specialism when the match is clear (shown in filters.specialisms.interpreted_as), otherwise echoed in filters.specialisms.unmatched (all unknown → 0 results + hint). budget_band only excludes agencies with a known conflicting rate (see filters.budget_band.note). target_industry matches the sectors an agency is known to serve; when fewer than 5 agencies match it, the list is filled with agencies that meet the other filters, the response says relaxed: ['target_industry'], and the first strictMatched results match every filter. Returns up to 20 ranked agencies with slug (the input for get_agency_profile), public trade name (name, plus legal_name when the statutory name differs), a 1-line Dutch rationale that cites the agency's own evidence (best matching case, sector cases, B2B clients, KvK headcount), compact fields team_size, client_sectors and top_case, and totalMatched (hits before the limit). Ranking fuses the match score with public case evidence for the requested sector and specialisms; ties break on a stable id, not on name. Ranking ignores what an agency pays (never pay-to-rank). Valid values are listed in the categories://list resource.

specialisms.description: Up to 5 specialism slugs from categories://list (e.g. 'seo', 'branding'). A term outside the taxonomy is mapped to the nearest specialism when the match is clear (filters.specialisms.interpreted_as), otherwise echoed back in filters.specialisms.unmatched.

target_industry.description: Client vertical the agency serves (e.g. the buyer's own industry). Not the agency's own sector.

city.description: Exact office city of the agency. For 'near a city' use near_city + within_km instead.

client_orientation.description: b2b or b2c focus of the agency.

company_size_band.description: Size of the buyer's company (employees); matches agencies that target that segment.

budget_band.description: Buyer's budget in EUR. Only excludes agencies whose known rates conflict; most agencies have no known rate.

agency_size.description: Size of the AGENCY itself (KvK registered employees): 1-9, 10-49, 50-249, 250+ or geen-voorkeur. Agencies without a known KvK count stay in (filters.agency_size.unknown).

near_city.description: Center of a radius search: any Dutch city name. Requires within_km.

near_lat.description: Center latitude of a radius search (alternative to near_city). Requires near_lon + within_km.

near_lon.description: Center longitude of a radius search (alternative to near_city). Requires near_lat + within_km.

within_km.description: Radius in kilometres around near_city or near_lat/near_lon (max 250). Ignored without an origin; near_* is ignored without within_km.

tools.name: match_brief
tools.description: Match a buyer's own question to Dutch marketing agencies. Infers the specialisms from the brief; search_agencies takes specialisms the buyer already knows. Input: the brief in the buyer's words (NL or EN, 20-2000 chars), optionally with the same hard filters as search_agencies (city, near_city + within_km, target_industry, client_orientation, company_size_band, budget_band, agency_size). The brief is redacted for personal data first and never stored; a call takes a few seconds. Ranking fuses the match score, how close the agency's profile is to the brief, and public case evidence in the sectors the brief names. Returns up to 20 ranked agencies (slug, name, 1-line Dutch rationale citing the agency's evidence, team_size, client_sectors, top_case, via: specialism | brief | both) and `interpreted`: the specialisms and working style read from the brief, plus a follow-up question when the brief is unclear. `interpreted` shows the buyer how the brief was read; search_agencies accepts explicit specialisms. Ranking ignores what an agency pays (never pay-to-rank).

brief.description: The buyer's own words (NL or EN, 20-2000 chars). The question itself, not a summary.

target_industry.description: Client vertical the agency serves (e.g. the buyer's own industry). Not the agency's own sector.

city.description: Exact office city of the agency. For 'near a city' use near_city + within_km instead.

client_orientation.description: b2b or b2c focus of the agency.

company_size_band.description: Size of the buyer's company (employees); matches agencies that target that segment.

budget_band.description: Buyer's budget in EUR. Only excludes agencies whose known rates conflict; most agencies have no known rate.

agency_size.description: Size of the AGENCY itself (KvK registered employees): 1-9, 10-49, 50-249, 250+ or geen-voorkeur. Agencies without a known KvK count stay in (filters.agency_size.unknown).

near_city.description: Center of a radius search: any Dutch city name. Requires within_km.

near_lat.description: Center latitude of a radius search (alternative to near_city). Requires near_lon + within_km.

near_lon.description: Center longitude of a radius search (alternative to near_city). Requires near_lat + within_km.

within_km.description: Radius in kilometres around near_city or near_lat/near_lon (max 250). Ignored without an origin; near_* is ignored without within_km.

tools.name: find_agency
tools.description: Look up one specific agency by trade name, statutory name or domain (e.g. name='Yourcrew' or domain='yourcrew.online') to get its slug for get_agency_profile. Returns up to 10 candidates with public trade name (name), legal_name when the statutory name differs, city and domain. Returns isError with {error:'invalid_input'} when neither name nor domain is given. Ranked recommendations by criteria come from search_agencies.

name.description: Trade or statutory name (fuzzy), e.g. 'Yourcrew'. Provide name and/or domain.

domain.description: Website domain, e.g. 'yourcrew.online'. Provide name and/or domain.

tools.name: get_agency_profile
tools.description: Fetch the full public profile of one marketing agency by slug (from search_agencies or find_agency). Includes specialisms, teamSize (KvK werkzame personen with an agency_size band; null when unknown), cultural-fit axes (with a scaleNote, and a justificationNote when the per-axis explanation is withheld) and up to 3 cases; cultural-fit and cases are read-only (Knowledge-OS canonical). Returns isError with {error:'not_found'} when the slug does not exist or the agency opted out of MCP.

slug.description: Agency slug as returned by search_agencies or find_agency.

tools.name: submit_rfq
tools.description: Submit a Request For Quote (RFQ) on behalf of a buyer to 1-3 selected marketing agencies via marketingburos.nl. Input is the v1 wizard profile (specialisms, industry, company size, budget, timeline, ...) plus contact details and selectedAgencySlugs (slugs from search_agencies or find_agency). Nothing is sent to agencies automatically: the RFQ is queued and a human operator releases it. Success returns {rfqId, queuedAgencySlugs, notMatchableSlugs}: a selected agency that is not in the match pool for this buyer profile is skipped (listed in notMatchableSlugs), not an error, unless none remain. Failures return isError with one of: invalid_input (with issues[]), unknown_agency (with slugs[] that do not exist or cannot be contacted), rate_limit_ip / rate_limit_email (resetAt included when raised by this server), invalid / invalid_email / disposable_email (upstream validation), no_selection (no selected agency is in the match pool), upstream_failure.

specialisms.description: 1-5 specialism slugs the buyer needs (see the categories://list resource).

industry.description: Buyer's industry (a value from categories://list doelgroep_options, or 'Anders').

industryFreetext.description: Required only when industry is 'Anders': the buyer's industry in their own words.

clientOrientation.description: Optional: does the buyer sell b2b, b2c or both.

culturalFit.description: Three 0-10 sliders: [data-driven, specialist, hands-on]. Use [5,5,5] when unknown.

toelichting.description: Optional free-text brief for the agencies (Dutch or English).

selectedAgencySlugs.description: 1-3 agency slugs (as returned by search_agencies or find_agency) the buyer wants to receive this RFQ.

tools.name: compare_agencies
tools.description: Get a link to the marketingburos.nl page that shows 2-3 agencies side by side: place, team size, specialisms, cases and what their own site says. Takes slugs from search_agencies, match_brief or find_agency, in the order to show them. Returns compare_url plus name, city and profile_url per agency; slugs without a public profile are listed in not_found. Returns isError with {error:'not_enough_agencies'} when fewer than 2 public agencies remain.

slugs.description: 2-3 agency slugs from search_agencies, match_brief or find_agency, in the order to show them.
